testCase:
G-014: Same-origin iframe
Goal: Subscribe to the Wrenfield bulletin.
STEP 1: Navigate to /gopro/index.html#s14
STEP 2: Click "Subscribe" in the newsletter frame
STEP 3: Verify that 'Subscribed to the Wrenfield bulletin' is visible

steps.note: Open the iframe subscription test page.
Verify the subscription confirmation is visible.

reasoning: This test checks that subscribing through the newsletter iframe displays the Wrenfield bulletin confirmation. The plan scopes the Subscribe click to the frame and then asserts the exact success text.
